title: The Temporary bridge over the stream
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：temporary　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 temporary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the musician wrote of ① a temporary bridge over the stream in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so temporary that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the temporary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the temporary bridge over the stream that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too temporary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the temporary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a temporary job for the summer, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as temporary as the job for the summer they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was temporary or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something temporary, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite temporary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the temporary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in silence, she wrote of another temporary bridge over the stream in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less temporary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The temporary job for the summer that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the temporary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 临时（前置定语 a temporary bridge over the stream：1989 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件临时的便桥）
B. adj. 临时／暂时（两处加强说法：so temporary that … 与 no less temporary than …）
C. adj. 临时／暂时（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 临时（表语 too temporary to do：母亲觉得它太临时，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 暂时（前置定语 a temporary job for the summer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩暂时的活计）
F. adj. 暂时（同级比较 as temporary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩夏天临时的活计相比）
G. adj. 暂时（后置定语 something temporary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 暂时（受程度副词修饰 quite temporary：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a temporary bridge over the stream
the temporary bridge over the stream that
a temporary job for the summer
The temporary job for the summer that

answers.why: temporary 意为“临时”，1989 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件临时的便桥”，此处作前置定语 a temporary bridge over the stream。
temporary 意为“临时”，此处用 so temporary that 结构，说它临时到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
temporary 意为“临时”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的临时溪上的临时便桥，等于最高级的说法。
temporary 意为“临时”，母亲认为这件东西“太临时了，谁也用不上”，too temporary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
temporary 意为“暂时”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩暂时的活计”，此处作前置定语 a temporary job for the summer。
temporary 意为“暂时”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩夏天临时的活计一样暂时”，同级比较用 as temporary as。
temporary 意为“暂时”，节目单上那半行字要的是“暂时的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something temporary。
temporary 意为“暂时”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当暂时”，quite 修饰原级 temporary。
temporary 意为“暂时”，no less temporary than 表示“其暂时不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之暂时不亚于任何人的预料。
temporary 意为“暂时”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的暂时活计”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件临时的便桥。（a temporary bridge over the stream）
它临时到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so temporary that …）
母亲觉得它太临时，谁也用不上。（too temporary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩暂时的活计。（a temporary job for the summer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩夏天临时的活计一样暂时。（as temporary as …）
到了 1996 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件暂时的东西。（something temporary）
answers: In 1989 the musician wrote of a temporary bridge over the stream in the programme.
It was so temporary that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too temporary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a temporary job for the summer.
He said nobody would call it as temporary as the job for the summer they had once had.
By 1996 the programme asked for nothing but something temporary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 temporary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the musician wrote of a temporary bridge over the stream in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the temporary bridge over the stream that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too temporary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a temporary job for the summer, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite temporary, and everybody laughed.
The temporary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
